AP25J1-08.fixture: Club León vs Atlético San Luis

primary_singles.learning: The model and pregame context both favored América, yet the match drew 1-1. One loss does not invalidate the exact-price disagreement; it does show that supportive narrative cannot be treated as certainty.

The match produced five goals despite the preregistered Puebla low-attack warning. Team-specific attacking weakness does not automatically imply a match under; opponent contribution and matchup openness matter.

A high-probability favorite at an exact archived price converted. Toluca's championship/home strength survived a credible Necaxa opponent; preserve as a normal hit, not evidence to increase favorite stakes.

This is the most informative J1 context residual: the strongest contextual contradiction won 3-0. Context cannot be promoted as a veto based on plausible narratives alone; it needs prospective measurement against MODEL_ONLY.

Pregame context strongly supported Monterrey after its Club World Cup performance, but Pachuca won 3-0. This is the mirror image of Santos: contextual support can also be wrong, reinforcing the need for formal feature tests rather than narrative overrides.

A 24.8% model probability can still be an attractive bet when the price only requires 18.9% to break even. This is a clean teaching example: good betting is not the same as choosing the safest-looking event.

secondary_two_leg_parlays.learning: One miss killed the ticket; the packaging added no value despite one correct leg.
The 2-leg diagnostic amplified two successful singles, but a single winning parlay is not evidence that two-leg packaging has edge.
Again one miss erased the winning leg, illustrating why parlays remain secondary rather than the bankroll engine.

dynamic_10pct_counterfactual.method: same frozen portfolio scaled pro-rata from MXN100 exposure

selected_single_metrics.note: Calibrated shadow outperformed raw on J1 selected singles, but J1 is not promotion-eligible due researcher outcome exposure and n=6 is tiny. Preserve only as diagnostic evidence.

learning: Singles-primary architecture produced positive economics in J1: 4/6 singles, +64.70 MXN on 85 staked. The result was driven materially by two correctly priced underdog wins, Santos 4.33 and San Luis 5.30.
Only 1/3 two-leg parlays won, yet the winning Saturday parlay added +30.073. Keep two-leg parlays secondary; do not infer superiority from one jornada.
Context produced opposite-sign residuals: CONTRADICT_HIGH Santos won, while SUPPORT Monterrey X2 lost. This argues strongly for measuring context rather than allowing free-form human vetoes.
Puebla Over 2.5 hit despite Puebla LOW_ATTACK risk. Separate team scoring deterioration from total-match goal environment.
The calibration shadow improved Brier/log loss on this six-bet sample, but no promotion is allowed. J2 onward must restore full researcher blindness and provide clean prospective evidence.
The MXN100 windowed budget worked operationally: 35 Friday / 35 Saturday / 30 Sunday, no profit recycling and no chasing.
